The '''2015 FA Community Shield''' (also known as '''The FA Community Shield supported by [[McDonald's]]''' for sponsorship reasons)<ref name=btdeal>{{cite web |title=The Community Shield will be screened live on BT Sport |url=https://www.thefa.com/news/competitions/fa-community-shield/2015/jun/the-fa-community-shield-2015 |website=TheFA.com |publisher=The Football Association |date=23 June 2015 |access-date=2 August 2015}}</ref> was the 93rd [[FA Community Shield]], an annual English [[association football|football]] match played between the winners of the previous season's [[Premier League]] and [[FA Cup]]. The match was contested by [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]], the [[2014–15 FA Cup]] winners, and [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]], champions of the [[2014–15 Premier League]]. It was held at [[Wembley Stadium]] on 2 August 2015. Watched by a crowd of 85,437 and a television audience of over a million, Arsenal won the match 1–0 to retain the Shield, having also won it in [[2014 FA Community Shield|2014]].

This was Arsenal's 21st Shield appearance and Chelsea's 11th. [[Petr Čech]] made his competitive debut for Arsenal against his former team, while captain [[Mikel Arteta]] and striker [[Olivier Giroud]] were named as substitutes. [[Gary Cahill]] was passed fit to start for Chelsea alongside captain [[John Terry]], and [[Loïc Rémy]] started up-front as [[Diego Costa]] was absent.
 
The only goal of the match came near the midway point of the first half; [[Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain]] collected a pass from [[Theo Walcott]] from the right and scored past [[Thibaut Courtois]]. Both managers did not shake hands after the game, which drew media attention. Arsenal's victory was their first against Chelsea in over three years and manager [[Arsène Wenger]]'s first over [[José Mourinho]] in 14 attempts.

==Background and pre-match==
[[File:Arsenal_FA_Cup_Winners_Parade_(18351309601).jpg|thumb|left|Arsenal's victory parade after winning the [[2015 FA Cup final]], which qualified them for the Community Shield.]]
The [[FA Community Shield]] was founded in 1908 as a successor to the [[Sheriff of London Charity Shield]],<ref>{{cite news |title=Abandonment of the Sheriff Shield |page=11 |newspaper=The Observer |publisher=Guardian News and Media |location=London |date=19 April 1908}}</ref> and began as a contest between the respective champions of the [[The Football League|Football League]] and [[Southern Football League|Southern League]], although in 1913 it was played between an Amateurs XI and a Professionals XI.<ref>{{cite news |title=The F.A. Charity Shield |page=10 |newspaper=The Times |publisher=News Corporation |location=London |date=7 October 1913}}</ref> In 1921, it was played by the league champions of the top division{{#tag:ref|The [[Premier League]] replaced the [[Football League First Division]] at the top of the [[English football league system|English football pyramid]] after its inception in 1992.<ref>{{cite news |first=Alex |last=Fynn |title=Continental or the full English? |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2001/dec/02/sport.sportfeatures |newspaper=The Observer |publisher=Guardian News and Media |location=London |date=2 December 2001 |access-date=2 August 2015 }}</ref>|group=lower-alpha}} and [[FA Cup]] winners for the first time.<ref>{{cite news|last=Ferguson|first=Peter|date=4 August 2011|title=The FA Community Shield history|website=mcfc.co.uk|publisher=Manchester City FC|url=http://www.mcfc.co.uk/news/team-news/archive/2011/august/community-shield-2011/the-shield-from-the-beginning|url-status=live|access-date=2 August 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140727202652/http://www.mcfc.co.uk/news/team-news/archive/2011/august/community-shield-2011/the-shield-from-the-beginning|archive-date=27 July 2014}}</ref>

[[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] qualified for the 2015 FA Community Shield as winners of the [[2014–15 Premier League]]. It was the club's fourth league title in ten years and third under the management of [[José Mourinho]].<ref>{{cite news |first=Henry |last=Winter |title=Eden Hazard scores as hosts crowned Premier League champions |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/competitions/premier-league/11580288/Chelsea-1-Crystal-Palace-0-match-report-Eden-Hazard-scores-as-hosts-crowned-Premier-League-champions.html |newspaper=The Daily Telegraph |publisher=Telegraph Media Group |location=London |date=3 May 2015 |access-date=2 August 2015 }}</ref> The other Community Shield place went to Arsenal, who defeated [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa]] by four goals to win the [[2015 FA Cup final]] and retain the trophy. In doing so, Arsenal had overtaken Manchester United to become the most successful club in the competition's history, with 12 titles.<ref>{{cite news |first=Daniel |last=Taylor |title=FA Cup final: Alexis Sánchez inspires Arsenal to win over Aston Villa |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2015/may/30/fa-cup-final-arsenal-aston-villa-alexis-sanchez |newspaper=The Observer |publisher=Guardian News and Media |location=London |date=31 May 2015 |access-date=2 August 2015}}</ref>

Chelsea made their eleventh appearance in the Community Shield; prior to this they won four ([[1970 FA Charity Shield|1970]], [[2000 FA Charity Shield|2000]], [[2005 FA Community Shield|2005]], [[2009 FA Community Shield|2009]]) and lost six, most recently in [[2012 FA Community Shield|2012]] against [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]].<ref name=rsssf>{{cite web|title=England – List of FA Charity/Community Shield Matches |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablese/engsupcuphist.html |access-date=1 June 2015 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305035734/http://rsssf.com/tablese/engsupcuphist.html |archive-date=5 March 2016 |website=[[RSSSF]] |df=dmy }}</ref> By contrast, Arsenal made their 21st Community Shield appearance, and won 13, including one shared in [[1991 FA Charity Shield|1991]]. They went into the match as holders of the Shield, having defeated Manchester City [[2014 FA Community Shield|a year earlier]]. Both clubs had only once met before in the Shield, when Chelsea won by two goals to one in 2005.<ref name=rsssf/> Arsenal had failed to beat Chelsea in all competitions since 2011, and  Mourinho was undefeated against his opponent [[Arsène Wenger]] in 13 matches.<ref>{{cite news |first1=Rick |last1=Glanvill |first2=Paul |last2=Dutton |title=Pre-match briefing: Chelsea v Arsenal – part two |url=http://www.chelseafc.com/news/latest-news/2015/07/pre-match-briefing--chelsea-v-arsenal---part-two.html |publisher=Chelsea F.C. |date=1 August 2015 |access-date=11 August 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |first=Sam |last=Wallace |title=Community Shield: Arsene Wenger needs to strike first blow in rivalry with Jose Mourinho |url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/premier-league/community-shield-arsene-wenger-needs-to-strike-first-blow-in-rivalry-with-jose-mourinho-10431971.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150801022528/http://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/premier-league/community-shield-arsene-wenger-needs-to-strike-first-blow-in-rivalry-with-jose-mourinho-10431971.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=1 August 2015 |newspaper=The Independent |location=London |date=31 July 2015 |access-date=11 August 2015}}</ref> Mourinho told reporters a winless run was something he would not tolerate: “I would try to answer, not because of a mental block but because I would want to try to find solutions to help my team to do it – try to find a different way, try to find the reasons why it goes all the time against my team."<ref name=mou>{{cite news |first=David |last=Hytner |title=José Mourinho: I would not endure winless run against me like Wenger |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2015/jul/31/chelsea-jose-mourinho-winless-run-arsene-wenger-arsenal-community-shield |newspaper=The Guardian |publisher=Guardian News and Media |location=London |date=31 July 2015 |access-date=11 August 2015}}</ref> He also attempted to play down the significance of the match, given Arsenal had won the previous year's contest but finished third in the league.<ref name=mou/>

The match was televised live in the United Kingdom on [[BT Sport|BT Sport 2]];<ref name=btdeal/> the network obtained rights to the Community Shield in July 2013 and were into their second year of a deal with the [[BBC]] and the FA.<ref>{{cite news|date=17 July 2013|title=FA confirms new TV deals|website=TheFA.com|publisher=The Football Association|url=https://www.thefa.com/News/2013/jul/bt-sport-bbc-itv-2014-18.aspx|url-status=dead|access-date=2 August 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130721021510/https://www.thefa.com/News/2013/jul/bt-sport-bbc-itv-2014-18.aspx|archive-date=21 July 2013}}</ref> The game was also the inaugural broadcast of BT Sport's [[4K resolution|4K ultra HD]] feed.<ref name=techradar-btsport4k>{{cite web|title=Behind the scenes of BT Sport's 4K Ultra HD revolution|url=http://www.techradar.com/us/news/television/behind-the-scenes-of-bt-sport-s-4k-ultra-hd-revolution-1301138|website=Techradar|access-date=23 January 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160129202408/http://www.techradar.com/us/news/television/behind-the-scenes-of-bt-sport-s-4k-ultra-hd-revolution-1301138|archive-date=29 January 2016|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}}</ref>

==Match==

===Team selection===
Chelsea were predicted to line up in a [[4-2-3-1|4–2–3–1]] formation, with [[Willian (footballer, born 1988)|Willian]] and [[Eden Hazard]] as wide men.<ref name="form">{{cite news |title=Wenger claims Hazard is not in same league as Messi |page=S2 |newspaper=The Sunday Telegraph |publisher=Telegraph Media Group |first=Simon |last=Collings |location=London |date=2 August 2015}}</ref> Mourinho doubted the fitness of [[Diego Costa]] and [[Gary Cahill]] going into the match – the former aggravated his hamstring during a pre-season game against [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Chelsea duo Gary Cahill and Diego Costa doubts for match with Arsenal |url=https://www.skysports.com/football/news/11668/9927905/chelsea-duo-gary-cahill-and-diego-costa-doubts-for-match-with-arsenal |publisher=Sky Sports |date=29 July 2015 |access-date=5 August 2015}}</ref> Arsenal were expected to line up similarly to Chelsea, with Walcott furthest forward and [[Mesut Özil]] in his preferred position as playmaker.<ref name="form"/><ref>{{cite news |title=Mesut Özil becomes central to Arsène Wenger's way of thinking at Arsenal |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2015/aug/01/mesut-ozil-arsene-wenger-arsenal |first=Amy |last=Lawrence |newspaper=The Guardian |publisher=Guardian News and Media |location=London |date=1 August 2015 |access-date=5 August 2015}}</ref> Midfielder [[Jack Wilshere]] was ruled out of selection, having sustained an ankle injury during training.<ref>{{cite news |title=Arsene Wenger reveals extent of Jack Wilshere's latest ankle injury |url=http://www.express.co.uk/sport/football/595568/Arsenal-News-Arsene-Wenger-Jack-Wilshere-Ankle-Injury-Community-Shield-Chelsea |first=James |last=Cambridge |newspaper=Daily Express |location=London |date=2 August 2015 |access-date=5 August 2015}}</ref> Arsenal's top scorer of the previous season, [[Alexis Sánchez]], was rested, having won the [[2015 Copa América]] with [[Chile national football team|Chile]] earlier in the summer.<ref>{{cite news|last=Orr |first=James |title=Alexis Sanchez: Arsene Wenger confirms forward will miss the Community Shield and the start of the season after Copa America win|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/news-and-comment/alexis-sanchez-arsene-wenger-confirms-forward-will-miss-the-community-shield-and-the-start-of-the-season-10386890.html |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/20220501/https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/news-and-comment/alexis-sanchez-arsene-wenger-confirms-forward-will-miss-the-community-shield-and-the-start-of-the-season-10386890.html |archive-date=1 May 2022 |url-access=subscription|newspaper=The Independent |location=London |date=14 July 2015 |access-date=7 August 2015}}{{cbignore}}</ref> The teamsheets showed [[Loïc Rémy]] starting the match for Chelsea up front and [[Cesc Fàbregas]] partnering Matic in midfield. As expected [[Petr Čech]] started in goal for Arsenal; the goalkeeper moved from Chelsea in search of first-team football.<ref>{{cite news|date=2 August 2015|title=Arsenal 1 Chelsea 0|publisher=Wembley Stadium|url=http://www.wembleystadium.com/Press/Press-Releases/2015/8/Arsenal-1-Chelsea-0|url-status=live|access-date=5 August 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150907135020/https://www.wembleystadium.com/Press/Press-Releases/2015/8/Arsenal-1-Chelsea-0|archive-date=7 September 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Petr Cech: Arsenal sign keeper from Chelsea in £10m deal |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/33318367 |publisher=BBC Sport |date=29 June 2015 |access-date=11 August 2015}}</ref>

===Summary===

====First half====
[[File:Arsenal 1 Chelsea 0 (20071401648).jpg|thumb|Chelsea's [[Loïc Rémy]] and [[Nemanja Matić]] and the Arsenal defence]]
Chelsea, in their usual home strip of blue, kicked off the match and immediately lost possession when Walcott dispossessed Matic. Walcott sent the ball to [[Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain]], whose cross on the right forced a punch from [[Thibaut Courtois]].<ref name=guard>{{cite news |first=Alan |last=Smith |title=Arsenal 1–0 Chelsea: Community Shield – as it happened! |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2015/aug/02/arsenal-v-chelsea-community-shield-2015-live |work=theguardian.com |publisher=Guardian News and Media |location=London |date=2 August 2015 |access-date=2 August 2015 }}</ref> [[Francis Coquelin]] conceded a free kick in the sixth minute having fouled Willian inside Chelsea's half, though nothing came of the set piece. Fàbregas went down under the challenge of [[Per Mertesacker]] in Arsenal's penalty area soon afterwards, but his appeal for a penalty kick was turned down by referee [[Anthony Taylor (referee)|Anthony Taylor]] and play resumed.<ref name="bbcm">{{cite news|last=Rose|first=Gary|date=2 August 2015|title=How Arsenal won the Community Shield|publisher=BBC Sport (British Broadcasting Corporation)|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/live/football/33500342|url-status=live|access-date=2 August 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150803201755/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/live/football/33500342|archive-date=3 August 2015}}</ref> Chelsea, having settled the slower of the two teams, began to dominate ball possession and won two early corners, both of which were easily dealt with. In the 17th minute, [[Nacho Monreal]]'s charge forward was stopped by Cahill; the Chelsea defender in the process of making that challenge had suffered a nose bleed.<ref name=guard/> A free kick for Arsenal presented a chance for Walcott to score, but his header goalwards was saved.<ref name=teleg>{{cite news |first=Adam |last=Hurrey |title=Arsenal 1–0 Chelsea, Community Shield 2015: as it happened |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/arsenal/11769945/Arsenal-1-0-Chelsea-Community-Shield-2015-as-it-happened.html |work=The Daily Telegraph |publisher=Telegraph Media Group |location=London |date=2 August 2015 |access-date=2 August 2015}}</ref>

Arsenal scored the game's only goal in the 24th minute; set-up by Walcott, Oxlade-Chamberlain managed to cut inside [[César Azpilicueta]] on the right and shoot the ball into the top-left corner of Courtois's net.<ref name=bbcm/> It was the first goal Chelsea had conceded against Arsenal in 506 minutes.<ref name=teleg/> Most of the action in the first half was conducted in a congested midfield, with Fàbregas attempting to sedate the rhythm and the Arsenal midfielders forcing their opponents to play narrow.<ref name=guard/> This favoured Arsenal, who had space to counter-attack had Chelsea lost the ball.<ref name=guard/> [[Ramires]] nearly levelled the scoreline in the 33rd minute, but his curling effort failed to creep into the bottom right-hand corner.<ref name=teleg/> Ramires then missed another chance, heading the ball high and over the Arsenal goal after good work by Rémy. Arsenal created another chance to score four minutes before the break, when Oxlade-Chamberlain's cross found Monreal, who under pressure from Ivanovic headed over.<ref name=teleg/> Rémy, often a lone figure upfront, was ruled offside late on.<ref name=teleg/>

====Second half====
[[File:Arsenal 1 Chelsea 0 (19638448383).jpg|thumb|left|Chelsea's [[Willian (footballer, born 1988)|Willian]] (left) and [[Radamel Falcao]], who made his professional debut for the club.]]
[[Radamel Falcao]] replaced Rémy after the break and his long-range shot in the 48th minute was blocked. Although Chelsea started the half well, it was Arsenal who fashioned the notable chances before the hour mark.<ref name=guard/> In the 50th minute [[Santi Cazorla]] attempted to thread the ball through Chelsea's defence for Walcott to reach but his pass was cleared. Two minutes later Coquelin over-hit his pass which was directed to Özil, who roamed freely.<ref name=guard/> Chelsea made another change, this time [[Oscar (footballer, born 1991)|Oscar]] in place of Ramires in the 53rd minute. Seven minutes later Chelsea came close to scoring when [[Eden Hazard]] managed to evade his markers, but through on goal failed to get his shot on target, hitting over.<ref name=bbcm/> Azpilicueta was shown the game's first yellow card for pulling Oxlade-Chamberlain back; Mourinho made the decision to substitute him with [[Kurt Zouma]] in the 69th minute. Giroud came on for Walcott moments before, and immediately was involved in the action, shooting high and then from long range.<ref name=guard/>

Coquelin then was booked for his foul on Oscar, which earned Chelsea a free kick. Oscar's attempt was saved by Čech, who fisted the ball round the post.<ref name=bbcm/> Chelsea continued to attack, though Arsenal withstood their pressure. [[John Terry]] rose highest from a corner in the 74th minute and headed the ball in Zouma's direction, which eventually was caught by Čech.<ref name=bbcm/> Hazard's shot was blocked in the 79th minute and Oscar then spurned a chance, with Falcao unable to create something from it.<ref name=teleg/> In an effort to find an equaliser with ten minutes of normal time remaining, Mourinho brought on Moses in place of Terry and deployed a three-man defence.<ref name=guard/> It nearly presented Arsenal the chance to score their second of the match, but for Cazorla to have his effort blocked and [[Aaron Ramsey]] on the rebound shooting wide.<ref name=bbcm/>
{{-}}

==Post-match==
[[File:Arsène Wenger (20064534156).jpg|thumb|upright=0.75|Wenger won his sixth Community Shield as Arsenal manager]]
Wenger and Mourinho did not shake hands after the final whistle; Mourinho congratulated Arsenal's players as they descended the Wembley steps upon lifting the Shield, but the Arsenal manager appeared to avoid his Chelsea counterpart after he had collected his winner's medal.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Steinberg |first1=Jacob |title=José Mourinho says Arsenal ditched attacking philosophy to beat Chelsea |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2015/aug/02/jose-mourinho-arsenal-chelsea-community-shield-wenger |access-date=20 January 2021 |work=The Guardian |date=2 August 2015}}</ref>
 
In a post-match interview, Mourinho credited Arsenal's defensive approach and organisation, but felt "the best team lost", arguing that Chelsea created more chances and showed more initiative. He went on to suggest that Arsenal betrayed their attacking philosophy, choosing to adopt a counterattacking approach.<ref name=postm>{{cite news |first=Jacob |last=Steinberg |title=José Mourinho says Arsenal ditched attacking philosophy to beat Chelsea |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2015/aug/02/jose-mourinho-arsenal-chelsea-community-shield-wenger |newspaper=The Guardian |publisher=Guardian News and Media |location=London |date=2 August 2015 |access-date=4 August 2015 }}</ref> Although Wenger agreed his team were set-up cautiously, he denied they abandoned their playing style: "...we defend our game on togetherness and solidarity and on defending well and attacking well."<ref name=postm/> The Arsenal manager felt victory against Chelsea acted as a physiological boost for his players going into the new season, but was indifferent to his own record of beating Mourinho for the first time.<ref name=postm/>

Terry was disappointed with the result, observing "No matter if it’s a friendly or a Community Shield, it’s a trophy at the end of the day," but sought positives – focusing on how the players' fitness levels were rising in time for the new season.<ref>{{cite news |first=Stuart |last=Goodwin |title=John Terry: Community Shield defeat could be wake-up call Chelsea needed |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2015/aug/03/john-terry-community-shield-defeat-wake-up-call-chelsea-arsenal |newspaper=The Guardian |publisher=Guardian News and Media |location=London |date=3 August 2015 |access-date=4 August 2015 }}</ref> Mertesacker was delighted with his team's performance, describing it as the peak of their pre-season preparations.<ref>{{cite news |first=Jim |last=Van Wijk |title=We can launch a lasting league tilt, insists Per Mertesacker |url=http://www.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/sport/football/we-can-launch-a-lasting-league-tilt-insists-per-mertesacker-31424822.html |newspaper=Belfast Telegraph |date=4 August 2015 |access-date=4 August 2015 }}</ref>

Both managers criticised the quality of the pitch; Mourinho remarked that it "was a disaster... so bad and so slow."<ref name=postm/> An FA spokesperson said: "We will continue to improve the quality of the pitch, which we have every confidence in. In this instance it is simply that the pitch is less mature than we would ordinarily wish given the summer concert season and the early start to the football calendar."<ref name=postm/>

An average of 821,000 viewers watched the match live on BT Sport 2; the channel's coverage peaked at 1.2&nbsp;million (11.5% of the [[Audience measurement|audience share]]) from 16:40. Highlights on [[BBC One]] later that evening attracted 2.1&nbsp;million viewers (17%).<ref>{{cite news |first=Matthew |last=Campelli |title=Humans grips 2.8m series average |url=https://www.broadcastnow.co.uk/ratings/humans-grips-28m-series-average/5091190.article |work=Broadcast |location=London |date=3 August 2015 |access-date=4 August 2015 }} {{subscription required}}</ref>
